lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A multi-row horizontal arrangement of high-luminance circular blobs extending from the posterior margin of the gill slits across the mid-lateral flank. Centroids are organized in approximately five to six identifiable horizontal rows with semi-regular spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows at approximately 90-degree angles, creating a rectilinear grid of high-intensity anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent linear feature running horizontally along the dorsal-lateral transition, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal edge and a distinct shadow region directly below.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, non-linear white pigment pattern resembling a 'labyrinth' or curvilinear loop is visible in the region immediately dorsal to the pectoral fin and posterior to the gill slits, disrupting the standard grid pattern.
